author: reek
body: PBR with image-based lighting: a row of metallic spheres of increasing roughness reflecting a procedural environment (sky gradient, sun, ground). The reflection is sampled in the mirror direction; roughness fades it toward the average sky so rough metals look matte. A Fresnel rim and the sun's specular complete it. One thread per pixel. Reference site's "PBR image based lighting". Float from DeviceMath.
